title: santalodes roxburghii
intro: Santalodes roxburghii, commonly known as Roxburgh's sandalwood, is a species of flowering plant in the family Santalaceae. It is valued for its aromatic and medicinal properties, with potential health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Roxburgh's sandalwood are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation, which can be attributed to the bioactive constituents such as santalols, santalenes, and other sesquiterpenes. These bioactive constituents contribute to the plant's therapeutic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
